title: String Inverter vs Microinverter: A Guide for American Homeowners
excerpt: Understand the key differences between string inverters and microinverters for your solar energy system
content:
What are String Inverters and Microinverters?

When it comes to solar energy systems, two common types of inverters are string inverters and microinverters. Both play a crucial role in converting DC power from solar panels into AC power for your home.

String Inverter Benefits

String inverters are a traditional and cost-effective option for solar energy systems. They connect multiple solar panels in a series, converting DC power from all panels into AC power. However, if one panel is shaded or malfunctioning, it can affect the entire system's performance.

Microinverter Benefits

Microinverters, on the other hand, are a newer technology that connects to individual solar panels, converting DC power from each panel into AC power independently. This setup allows for better performance, even if one panel is shaded or malfunctioning.

Conclusion

When choosing between string inverters and microinverters, consider your solar energy system's size, budget, and performance requirements. While string inverters are cost-effective, microinverters offer better performance and flexibility.
